title: DTC registered-wallet readiness scenarios (preflight-harness)
disclaimer: DTC-shaped, not DTC-certified. Every Stellar row in this profile is inferred or unknown: DTCC has published no Stellar wallet, token or API requirements. Do not describe any output built on these rows as DTC-compatible.

scenarios.title: Participant G wallet with an authorised trustline is ready to receive
given: Classic asset with AUTH_REQUIRED and clawback; wallet funded, trustline created and authorised, reserve covered.
scenarios.when: the wallet is checked for ability to receive the asset with preflight-harness (library verdicts plus the DTC readiness evaluator)

scenarios.title: Step 1 done (trustline), step 2 pending (DTC authorisation): not ready

scenarios.title: Wallet has not created the trustline: not ready
